notes: Each requirement maps a group of frozen assertions in tests/test_outputs.py to the info_slices that carry the same information to the simulated user. must_include needles are literal substrings of the concatenated script_refs text (coverage invariant: info_slices must reproduce every piece of instruction information the verifier checks). The concrete legal value sets (aggregates, time units, scale types, marks, channels) are NOT enumerated here as needles: the instruction and verifier both derive them from the shipped Vega-Lite schema, so the contract records the source-of-truth pointer (si_legal_sets_source) rather than duplicating schema-derived lists.

requirements.verifier_assertion: alt.lint(chart) and chart.lint() are callable on every top-level chart class; altair.lint/LintIssue/LintError are importable and in __all__.
Linting a non-chart, non-dict input (str/int/None/list) raises TypeError; a plain spec dict is accepted.
lint does not mutate input, is idempotent, returns issues sorted by (path, code), and returns an empty list when clean.
Each issue carries code/severity/path/message; the offending value appears in the message; the root path is the empty string.
must_include: that offending value must appear in the message
the root chart uses the empty string

requirements.verifier_assertion: Path strings for single charts: encoding.<channel>, indexed list channels (encoding.tooltip[1]), 'mark', params[i].
Path strings for composed charts: layer[i], concat[i], hconcat[i], facet inner 'spec', facet.row/column/facet.
Shorthand handling consistent with parse_shorthand; explicit props override; shorthand+field illegal; value/datum skip field checks.
must_include: both a shorthand and an explicit field

requirements.verifier_assertion: Detection is static: the checker does not call to_dict() nor rely on serialization exceptions to find problems.
parse_shorthand gains an optional mode returning structured error info; default behavior unchanged byte-for-byte (regression tests).
must_include: returns error information as structured data

requirements.verifier_assertion: Legal channel/mark/aggregate/timeUnit/type/scale/stack/sort sets are those of the shipped Vega-Lite schema (source of truth).
must_include: union of the properties of Encoding and FacetedEncoding

requirements.verifier_assertion: E001 flags an unknown encoding channel key.
E002 flags a missing or illegal mark; boxplot/errorbar/errorband are legal; mark dict inspects type.
must_include: not in the legal mark set

requirements.verifier_assertion: E003 flags an illegal aggregate (e.g. 'wibble') on path encoding.y with the value in the message.
E004 flags an illegal timeUnit (utc-prefixed and 'binned' forms are legal).
E005 flags an illegal measurement type (legal: quantitative/ordinal/temporal/nominal/geojson).
must_include: quantitative, ordinal, temporal, nominal or geojson

requirements.verifier_assertion: E006 flags an illegal scale.type.
E007 flags scale/field-type mismatches (discrete-scale, temporal-scale, sequential); unknown field type is not reported.
must_include: Do not report E007 when the field's type is unknown

requirements.verifier_assertion: E008 flags an illegal stack value (legal: True/False/None/zero/center/normalize).
E009 flags an unparseable shorthand, or shorthand+field on the same channel (incl. tooltip[1]).
must_include: both a shorthand and an explicit field

requirements.verifier_assertion: E010 flags aggregate together with a truthy bin; bin='binned' is exempt.
must_include: non-empty aggregate and a truthy bin
does not count as a truthy bin

requirements.verifier_assertion: E011 flags an illegal sort string; a list or dict sort is not flagged.
must_include: Do not report E011 when sort is a list or a dict

requirements.verifier_assertion: E012 flags duplicate parameter names across the whole tree; the first occurrence is not reported (params[1], layer[0].params[0]).
E013 flags a bin string that is not 'binned'.
must_include: bin is a string but is not equal to "binned"

requirements.verifier_assertion: E014 flags an empty channel (no field/value/datum); count aggregate and value/datum are exempt.
must_include: no field, no value and no datum

requirements.verifier_assertion: W001 flags a secondary channel (x2/y2/longitude2/latitude2) whose primary is missing.
W002 flags a unit chart with no encoding; geoshape and shared-layer encoding are exempt.
W003 flags a channel with a field/aggregate but no explicit type.
to_dict/to_json gain strict_lint kw (default False, behavior unchanged); True raises LintError on E-level issues and propagates into subplots.

LintError subclasses ValueError, exposes .issues (E-level), args[0] is multi-line text, and str returns args[0]: a count header containing '{n} error' followed by a per-issue listing (codes and paths included).
Checker tolerates invalid-but-unserialized charts; facet-mapping channels and shared composed encodings are checked.
